items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: entertained General Eisenhower, Marshall Zukov -- when they -- Zukov presented Eisenhower with that medal

ctx.x: And they took me from Nancy, France, to Hamburg, Germany, to the command headquarters, and there's where I
entertained General Eisenhower, Marshall Zukov -- when they -- Zukov presented Eisenhower with that medal -- that's where it was, at the command headquarters in Hamburg. See?

And then let me see. What else happened? When I left there, I went -- went on someplace else with my USO show. I don't remember where, but I went from Hamburg to, you know, and in the meantime, Chris, I had worked nightclubs in -- in Holland. I played La Gaité -- this was after the war, though.
